# @jpisgeek/caddy

Manage a single route in an existing systemd Caddy wildcard site through your
configured Swamp SSH model.

**Version** `2026.09.04.1` · **License** MIT · **Source**
https://github.com/jpisgeek/slog-bog/tree/main/caddy

## Install

```
swamp extension pull @jpisgeek/caddy
```

## `@jpisgeek/caddy`

### Arguments

| argument          | type   | required | default                  | description                                                         |
| ----------------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `sshModel`        | string | yes      |                          | Existing @swamp/ssh model; its own credentials remain authoritative |
| `host`            | string | yes      |                          | One exact host name in the SSH model                                |
| `configPath`      | string | no       | `"/etc/caddy/Caddyfile"` |                                                                     |
| `caddyBinary`     | string | no       | `"/usr/bin/caddy"`       |                                                                     |
| `systemctlBinary` | string | no       | `"/usr/bin/systemctl"`   |                                                                     |

### Methods

#### `inspect`

Read the Caddyfile digest and active service state

No arguments.

#### `plan`

Render and validate one wildcard-host route without replacing live configuration

| argument         | type            | required | default | description                                          |
| ---------------- | --------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`           | string          | yes      |         |                                                      |
| `hostname`       | string          | yes      |         |                                                      |
| `wildcardDomain` | string          | yes      |         |                                                      |
| `upstream`       | string          | yes      |         |                                                      |
| `allowedCidrs`   | array of string | yes      |         |                                                      |
| `expectedSha256` | string          | yes      |         | Digest returned by inspect; refuses changes on drift |

#### `apply`

Validate, privately back up, atomically replace and reload one route; roll back
on reload failure

| argument         | type            | required | default | description                                          |
| ---------------- | --------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`           | string          | yes      |         |                                                      |
| `hostname`       | string          | yes      |         |                                                      |
| `wildcardDomain` | string          | yes      |         |                                                      |
| `upstream`       | string          | yes      |         |                                                      |
| `allowedCidrs`   | array of string | yes      |         |                                                      |
| `expectedSha256` | string          | yes      |         | Digest returned by inspect; refuses changes on drift |

### Data written

| resource    | lifetime | fields                                                                                                               | description                                                      |
| ----------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `operation` | infinite | `requestId`, `action`, `beforeSha256`, `afterSha256`, `changed`, `validated`, `serviceActive`, `backupPath`, `route` | Correlated Caddy operation; no full configuration or credentials |

## Example

```yaml
globalArguments:
  sshModel: proxy-access
  host: proxy
  configPath: /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
  caddyBinary: /usr/bin/caddy
  systemctlBinary: /usr/bin/systemctl
```

## Caveats

Requires Swamp and an installed @swamp/ssh model on the runner, Python 3 and
noninteractive sudo on the proxy. Supports exactly one plain wildcard site
header; imported configurations are refused. Environment-dependent validation
needs inspection before use. Run inspect, plan, apply in a serial Swamp
workflow. Supply the inspected digest to plan and apply. An interrupted reload
requires a fresh inspection; the verified original remains in a private backup
directory. DNS and backend networking are separate infrastructure operations.

## Security

Reuses the SSH model's existing authentication. No new SSH keys or TLS
credentials. Full Caddyfiles and command diagnostics stay on the proxy. Refuses
existing unmanaged host entries, stale digests, universal client CIDRs,
symlinked Caddyfiles and malformed route markers. Output contains only route
configuration, digests, status and a private backup path. The community
@evrardjp/caddy 2026.08.12.1 was reviewed as a design reference; no source was
copied. This implementation targets the existing systemd service.

See [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/jpisgeek/slog-bog/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
for the release gates every version passes before it reaches the registry.
